`<WORKER-BRIEF>`

**Task: audit finding 2A on flutter/flutter#196561**

You own branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback` (head `7233196849d`). An audit agent built a playground app against this PR in 28 configurations and wrote a report. This brief covers only finding 2A. Other findings will come to you in separate briefs, so keep any commit for 2A separate from work on the others.

**The finding, quoted from the report**

The report's method section says:

> **Verification**: Every output APK in `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/` and `build/app/outputs/apk/` was inspected with `aapt2 dump badging`.

Section 2A:

> ### 2A. Following the error message's `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` suggestion when no `versionCode` exists builds **un-installable APKs (`versionCode=''`)**
>
> When neither `android {}` nor `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` sets a `versionCode`:
> - **Flutter 3.47**: Used `-1` (`variant.mergedFlavor.versionCode`) and silently built APKs with `versionCode='999'`, `'1999'`, `'3999'` (`1000 * abi + (-1)`).
> - **PR #196561**: Fails cleanly (big improvement!), and prints:
>   > `Set versionCode = flutter.versionCode in defaultConfig (or on each product flavor), or pass -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true to keep one versionCode.`
>
> **Escape-Hatch Trap**
> If the developer follows the second suggestion on that exact project:
> ```bash
> flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true
> ```
> the build **exits `0`** and writes `app-armeabi-v7a-debug.apk`, `app-arm64-v8a-debug.apk`, and `app-x86_64-debug.apk` with **`versionCode=''` (empty / missing in the compiled binary `AndroidManifest.xml`)**. `adb install` rejects those APKs on Android devices. Saying *"to keep one versionCode"* when no `versionCode` exists anywhere misleads the user into producing broken APKs.

**What has been verified: nothing.** I have not reproduced any of this. The report includes no `aapt2` output, no exit code and no `adb install` output for 2A. Its method section mentions only `aapt2 dump badging`, so it is unclear whether anyone actually ran `adb install` or just inferred the rejection. Treat each claim as unverified until you reproduce it:

1. On the PR head, with no `versionCode` in `android {}` (including `defaultConfig` and flavors) and none in `src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, `flutter build apk --debug --split-per-abi` fails with the message quoted above.
2. Adding `-P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true` makes the build exit 0 and write the three per-ABI APKs.
3. `aapt2 dump badging` shows `versionCode=''` for those APKs.
4. `adb install` rejects them on an emulator or device. Record the exact error, API level and ABI. If the install succeeds, say so and report what version code the device shows (`adb shell dumpsys package <id> | grep versionCode`).
5. (Context, lower priority) Flutter 3.47 built `999`/`1999`/`3999` in the same setup.

**What I need decided.** Weigh this on its merits, and don't treat it as a fix order. After reproducing, decide whether code, tests, docs or the error message must change, or none of them, and explain why. One question to answer: should the escape hatch be offered, or allowed to build, when no versionCode exists anywhere? If claims 2–4 reproduce, this is not just a wording nit, so check whether the code must change before you settle on a docs or message tweak. If they don't reproduce, decline with the evidence.

**Report back with:**
- The exact commands and their outputs for items 1–4 (and 5 if you ran it), each marked "reproduced" or "not reproduced".
- Your decision: changed, modified or declined, with your reasons.
- Any test you added or updated that covers this case, and proof that it fails without your change.
- The commit SHA(s) and your new head. Push only to the `reidbaker-agent` fork.

Don't post anything on the PR about this finding. If a reply to a human reviewer is needed, draft it in your report and I'll pass it on.
